historical_reviews.deepseek: The user/FAE boundary is directionally sound, but the SSH grep does not prove Channel Mode m, current-range address membership, slot attribution, indicators or recovery and assumes Linux dmesg despite a Windows boot.

original_test_intent: Configure supported memory mirroring and inject one uncorrectable memory error at an address proven to be in the active mirrored range, then verify fatal mirror-UCE handling, DIMM attribution, applicable fault indications and controlled platform recovery.
original_method: A qualified FAE/operator applies the approved mirrored DIMM population and BIOS mode, captures `mc.addMap()` and `mc.dimminfo()`, proves Channel Mode `m`, selects one authorized aligned address from the current mirrored map, performs exactly one `mirror_uce` injection, observes OS/BMC/UEFI/front-panel/LCD behavior, recovers the SUT and restores or records the approved configuration.
manual_activity: The operator/FAE must configure mirror mode, approve the current mapped address, run one fatal injection, observe physical indicators, recover the SUT and restore settings. The agent must reject the source's bracketed address as non-executable.
required_inputs: Supported mirrored DIMM population/controller topology and expected usable capacity
Pre/post BIOS mirror/debug settings and reboot requirements
Supported Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash plus addMap/dimminfo/mirror_uce semantics
Exact current-run mirrored range, alignment rule and one owner-approved address
Expected crash/reboot/recovery timing, Windows/BMC/UEFI/indicator oracle and backup/restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle SUT with backup, stable power, independent console and FAE approval
Preserve complete logs and active address-map output before changing state
Verify address alignment and membership in the current mirrored range; never reuse an example or stale address
Perform one bounded injection and stop on map mismatch, unexpected target, data-integrity concern, unrecoverable crash or wrong indication
No automatic retry; recover and restore mirror/debug settings only under the approved runbook
agent_execution_scope: Validate captured map/address membership and collect read-only Windows, BMC, UEFI, health and recovery evidence
Do not choose an address, change BIOS/memory mode, inject, reset/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve mirror topology, capacity and controller coverage
Supply the package contract and live address-selection/alignment rule
Define fatal-event, DIMM-slot, crash/recovery and applicable front-panel/LCD/UEFI oracle
Approve backup, recovery, restoration and final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SSH grep is only partial post-event evidence; it cannot establish mirror mode, mapped target, injection success, slot attribution, indicator state or recovery, conflicts with Windows and weakens host trust.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the source, but do not execute `0x100004000[mirror range]`; the FAE must select one address from the captured live map and run `ei.injectMemError(<approved_mirror_address>, errType='mirror_uce')` once.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Mirror mode, Channel Mode m, controller 1~N and 30/15-minute estimates are preserved; no address or crash behavior is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture mirror map, capacity and health before injection; prove address membership/alignment; time-correlate one operator-run injection with Cscript, Windows/WHEA, BMC, UEFI and indicators; record crash/reboot/recovery and integrity; then restore and diff settings.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns the address placeholder, fatal behavior and optional physical evidence into explicit gates without changing the requested mirror-UCE stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A mirror keyword or generic UCE log does not prove the live mirrored address, correct DIMM attribution, fault indication or recoverability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale or non-mirrored address can target unintended memory, corrupt data or crash irrecoverably; mirror-mode changes alter topology and usable capacity.

project_override_considerations: The runtime physical address and fatal-injection behavior are material destructive parameters requiring fresh user/FAE approval. Missing map or recovery data blocks execution, never justifies a guessed value or DUT-failure claim.
expected_evidence: Supported population, pre/post capacity and BIOS mirror/debug configuration
Package hash, full `mc.addMap()`/`mc.dimminfo()` with Channel Mode m and mirrored ranges
Approved address with demonstrated membership/alignment and complete injection transcript
Time-correlated Windows/WHEA, BMC slot/UCE, applicable UEFI, front-panel/LCD evidence, recovery timeline, integrity/restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `0x100004000[mirror range]` is a non-executable placeholder, controller 1~N has no target/coverage matrix, Windows is paired with dmesg, and the UEFI/front-panel/LCD applicability plus crash/recovery behavior lack deterministic definitions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended mirror-UCE operation is identifiable and the missing live map, package, oracle and recovery plan are obtainable project inputs. The static review is complete; execution remains gated rather than semantically impossible.

review_improvement: This review blocks execution of a malformed example address and distinguishes a fatal mirror-UCE with recovery and asserted indicators from the preceding service-continuity failover case.
independent_technical_reasoning: Mirror UCE is both address- and topology-dependent. The injected physical address must be calculated from the active map produced by the current DIMM population and BIOS mode; the bracketed source text is not a runnable value. Unlike mirror failover, the expected event is uncorrectable and can crash Windows, so a generic log grep cannot establish correct behavior. The evidence must join injection success, exact slot attribution, physical indicators and bounded recovery/integrity. Because a qualified FAE can supply the map, package and recovery contract, REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is correct rather than BLOCKED.
